high_level_description: The image depicts a minimalist setup featuring a modern iMac computer with a sleek design. The monitor is displaying a motivational wallpaper that reads, "Don't wish for it. Work for it." Below the main text, there is an additional message: "Dreams are the whispers of our ambitions but they only come to fruition when paired with the symphony of hard work and dedication." The background of the wallpaper is a light beige color, with a large red geometric shape on the right side. The text is primarily black, with some parts highlighted in red for emphasis.
